topic_taught_twice: Yes: structured output is taught across three H2 sections with restated facts (validation errors not raising at L13, L167, L185, L231, L237, L452; forced-retry exception at L235, L242, L452, L502); Strands-managed history nearly verbatim at L95 and L854; the stateless-interrupt caveat four times (L701, L907, L978, L1027); nested-graph interrupts and checkpointing again at L1027 after L913/L978.
causes_or_scope_beyond_sources: Yes: L248 infers that a Python custom provider must implement structured output itself (contradicted by running a provider whose structured_output raises); L1036 asserts that most operational failures come from trusting defaults (no source); L544 and L585 extend Python-only scope to both SDKs; L997 turns the docs' marking rule into 'only these providers support prompt caching'; L1025 narrows Cipher's five OpenAI Agents SDK primitives to agents and handoffs.
top_issues: Runnable-code defect in the core service pattern: a successful structured call ends with stop_reason 'tool_use', so handle_request (L674) and handle_ticket (L709) report every classified ticket as Outcome.STOPPED with triage=None, route_stop_reason (L117) returns 'unexpected', and L672/L1023 claim otherwise. COMPLETED must also accept a set result.structured_output.

Claims beyond the sources: L248 says a Python custom provider must implement structured output (false for the tool path), L1036 gives an unsourced cause for most failures, L544/L585 state Python-only limit and checkpoint behaviour for both SDKs, L913 lists four of the five 'session' preset fields (model_state missing), L1025 narrows Cipher's five primitives to two, L401 presents strands-agents-tools as the default install although the README installs only strands-agents.

Topics taught more than once: structured output spread over three sections with the same facts restated (L13/L167/L185/L231/L452/L502), history management repeated (L95, L854), the stateless-interrupt caveat four times (L701, L907, L978, L1027); deployment promised (L54) without steps and no metrics.get_summary() example (checklist misses shared-agent-throw-scope and result-fields-incomplete persist).
